slides.heading: 1 — Pick a boring, specific problem
body: The money in 2026 isn't in flashy apps. It's in unsexy niches: LinkedIn tools, B2B utilities, tiny workflow fixes.
Find one painful task a specific group does every single week.

slides.heading: 2 — Let AI build the product
body: The Lisbon founder never hand-wrote code — AI generated the app from plain-English descriptions.
Tools like Cursor, Lovable and Replit turn a clear spec into a working product.

slides.heading: 3 — Make AI your entire team
body: He used AI to write the docs, answer support tickets, and draft the marketing too.
One person now runs what used to take five.

slides.heading: 4 — Win on distribution, not features
body: 72% of successful indie founders say distribution — not the product — was the deciding factor.
Post daily, build in public, and show up where your niche already hangs out.

slides.heading: 5 — Charge from day one
body: Free apps rarely pay off for solo builders. The ones hitting $20K-$62K/month charged real prices early.
